title: MacTech Federal Market
description: SAM.gov contract opportunities and entity lookup (BYOK) plus USASpending federal award data.
summary: SAM.gov contract opportunities and entity lookup (BYOK) plus USASpending federal award data.
offersHint: SAM.gov contract opportunities and entity lookup (BYOK) plus USASpending federal award data. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://www.mactechsolutionsllc.com/api/mcp/market

toolsPreview.name: search_opportunities
toolsPreview.description: Search active federal contract opportunities on SAM.gov: solicitations, presolicitations, sources sought, RFIs, and award notices - filterable by keywords, NAICS, set-aside (SDVOSB, 8(a), HUBZone, WOSB, small business), notice type, agency, and posted-date range (max 1 year). Call this when the user wants to find federal bidding opportunities or market intelligence on what agencies are buying. Uses a shared daily budget unless the caller supplies their own free SAM.gov key.

toolsPreview.name: lookup_entity
toolsPreview.description: Look up a federal contractor registration in SAM.gov by Unique Entity ID (UEI) or legal business name: registration status, CAGE code, physical address, business types (SDVOSB, 8(a), HUBZone, etc.), and NAICS codes. Call this to vet a teaming partner, check a competitor, or confirm an entity is award-eligible. Public registration sections only.

toolsPreview.name: search_awards
toolsPreview.description: Search actual federal contract awards on USAspending.gov - who won what, from which agency, for how much. Filter by keywords, NAICS, PSC, recipient name, agency, date range, and award amount. Keyless and unlimited. Call this for competitive intelligence ("who holds contracts in this space"), incumbent research, or agency spending patterns.

toolsPreview.name: get_award
toolsPreview.description: Get full detail for one federal award from USAspending.gov by its generated award id (from search_awards results, e.g. "CONT_AWD_...") - description, obligations, period of performance, awarding/funding agencies, recipient, and place of performance. Keyless.

toolsPreview.name: find_agency
toolsPreview.description: Resolve a federal agency name fragment to its official awarding-agency names (toptier and subtier) as USAspending knows them - use before search_awards or spending_by_category when unsure of the exact agency name. Keyless.

toolsPreview.name: find_naics
toolsPreview.description: Resolve an industry description to NAICS codes (or look up what a NAICS code means). Use before search_opportunities/search_awards to get the right code. Keyless.

toolsPreview.name: spending_by_category
toolsPreview.description: Aggregate federal contract spending by NAICS, PSC, recipient, or awarding agency over a date range, optionally filtered by keywords/NAICS/agency - market sizing in one call ("top contractors in NAICS 541512 last year", "which agencies buy the most cybersecurity"). Keyless.
